gloss: running speed; travel speed (of a vehicle)

definitions.gloss: running speed; travel speed; driving speed
definitions.explanation: The speed at which a vehicle is traveling. Used for cars, trains, bicycles, and other vehicles in both everyday and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: {走行速度|そうこうそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{区間|くかん}→区間：18759_kukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{走行速度|そうこうそくど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧60⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧だ。
examples.english: The average travel speed for this section is 60 km/h.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{走行速度|そうこうそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧にして、⟦{車間距離|しゃかんきょり}→車間距離：14858_shakankyori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}りましょう→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: On rainy days, keep your driving speed moderate and maintain plenty of distance between vehicles.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧ (running, traveling by vehicle) + ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ (speed, velocity). A standard term in driving, traffic engineering, and transportation contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{走行速度|そうこうそくど}: average travel speed
- ⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧{走行速度|そうこうそくど}: maximum travel speed
- {走行速度|そうこうそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to increase speed
- {走行速度|そうこうそくど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to reduce speed
- {走行速度|そうこうそくど}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: speed limit (while driving)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: speed — more general, applies to anything
- ⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧: speed — English loanword, casual
- ⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧: speed per hour (km/h or mph)
- ⟦{制限速度|せいげんそくど}→制限速度：26875_seigensokudo⟧: speed limit — the legal limit
